query:
SELECT f.id, f.osId, f.escolaId, f.categoria, f.createdAt,
       os.status as os_status
FROM os_fotos f
LEFT JOIN ordens_servico os ON os.id = f.osId
WHERE f.escolaId = 420261
ORDER BY f.createdAt;
